advisoryHistorySource.role: Known-advisory history by npm package and exact selected version.

currentResolvedLockfileAudit.limitation: The audit covers the resolved lockfile at review time; it is not a complete package security history.

review.boundary: Evidence generation is offline and consumes the committed dated review snapshot. Refreshing package/advisory observations is a separate explicit network command.
